title: Annual emergency drill: updated arrival plan
summary: A sample organization-wide notice showing how the Hub highlights a time-sensitive change and the action staff should take.
body: This fictional beta notice demonstrates the reusable Staff Hub update format. For the sample drill, staff would use the north assembly area and review the posted arrival sequence before September 3.
The key information is kept together: what changed, when it becomes effective, what action is needed, and who owns the update. No real emergency procedures are included in this beta.
actionText: Review the sample arrival sequence before the drill date.

title: North entrance work begins September 8
summary: A fictional Facilities notice demonstrates how temporary access information can remain prominent until work is complete.
body: This sample update shows how Facilities can explain a temporary access change without burying the practical details. Staff would use the main entrance during the example work window.
A future approved resource link could point to a map or project notice while Drive permissions remain authoritative.
actionText: Use the sample alternate entrance during the work window.

title: Evening intake handoff updated
summary: A sample checklist change shows how department-owned updates can be standardized and easy to scan.
body: The fictional evening intake handoff now follows a consistent sequence so the next shift receives the same core information every time.
This entry is sample content only. A real Programs publisher could later supply approved details through a separate publishing workflow.
actionText: Use the sample checklist for evening handoffs beginning August 28.

title: Dining room service schedule changes next week
